content: The dedicated CRUD module is `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` — it contains the full set of memo CRUD operations (create, get, list, update, delete, plus comments/link metadata).

q17.

`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

This module holds the memo CRUD mutations/queries — React Query hooks wrapping create/get/list/update/delete (plus comments and link metadata), as seen at `useMemoQueries.ts:116–296`. It imports and uses the generated Connect service client `memoServiceClient` (`useMemoQueries.ts:5`), which is created from the generated `MemoService` in `web/src/connect.ts:197` (`createClient(MemoService, transport)`).
